paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotion categories within the IEMOCAP dataset, representing the proportion of utterances classified into each emotion. The chart contains six slices, each representing a distinct emotion: “Sadness” (approximately 14.7%), “Anger” (approximately 14.9%), “Happiness” (approximately 8.1%), “Excitement” (approximately 14.7%), “Frustration” (25.1%), and “Neutral” (23.1%). The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in size; no slices are visually emphasized, and the chart includes percentage labels displayed directly within each segment.
